headline: Vanguard lead the conference with a losing record
dek: Vanguard's win at Point Loma on Wednesday carried them to the top of the conference table, though across the season they have lost seven matches and won six. Point Loma, whose run in conference play it ended, sit behind them and host Concordia Irvine next.
displaced_by: The standing dek's Chaminade figures no longer match the data, and Vanguard's win at Point Loma moved them to the top of the table.
